title: The Blessings of Pure Hands
logline: A daughter who washed her father's feet in their small Addis Ababa home carries his blessing through his death into her life as a software engineer.

shots.reason: Opens on the daughter's face as she serves, so the audience meets her before the ritual. Changed after test 2: viewers asked to see her face first instead of the hands.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up in profile of the girl kneeling on a woven mat in the family living room, holding a round brown clay water pitcher with both hands and pouring a thin stream of water into a wide metal basin, eyes lowered with care and humility, her face lit by warm golden light from a window off frame, no lamp, no candle
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in as water pours softly into the basin
shots.narration_am: በልጅነቴ የአባቴን እግር ሳጥብ፣ ልቤ በብዙ ምርቃት ይሞላ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: As a child, washing my father's feet, my heart would fill with so many blessings.

shots.reason: Puts father and daughter in one frame so the audience sees who blesses whom; the hand on the head is the film's motif.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium shot in the family living room: the father sits on the sofa with his feet in a metal basin of water; the girl kneels on the mat beside the basin and looks up at him; he rests one gentle hand on top of her head in blessing, warm pure smile
shots.motion_prompt: subtle slow pull-back with soft lamp glow
shots.narration_am: «እግዚአብሔር ይባርክሽ፤ በመንገድሽ እግዚአብሔር ይቅደምልሽ፣ በጥበብ እና በማስተዋል ያሳድግሽ» ይለኝ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: 'May God bless you, may He go before you on your path, may He raise you in wisdom and understanding,' he would say.

shots.reason: The close-up on the child's face is where the words land; it is the seed the rest of the film grows from.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up portrait of the girl's face looking up with trust and reverence, listening, warm golden rim light, the soft living room behind her
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push toward her eyes
shots.narration_am: ከንጹህ ልብ የወጡ ቃላት እንደ ዘር በውስጤ ተዘርተው አደጉ።
shots.narration_en: Words from a pure heart were sown in me like a seed, and they grew.

shots.reason: An ordinary Addis neighbourhood at dawn and an empty chair carry the time jump and the father's death without a funeral; the sunrise says the blessing outlives him.
shots.keyframe_prompt: wide shot at sunrise over an ordinary Addis Ababa neighbourhood: low houses with corrugated roofs, a few mid-rise apartment blocks, eucalyptus trees, Entoto hills in soft morning haze behind, an empty plastic chair on a small balcony in the foreground, peaceful dawn, no skyscrapers
shots.motion_prompt: slow pan across the sunlit highlands, mist drifting
shots.narration_am: ብዙ ዓመታት አለፉ፤ አባቴም ወደ ፈጣሪው ሄደ፣ ግን ምርቃቱ አብሮኝ ቆየ።
shots.narration_en: Many years passed. My father went home to his Creator, but his blessing stayed with me.

shots.reason: Shows the blessing fulfilled in her own time: the same girl, now a software engineer, at work in the city she grew up in.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium shot of the woman working as a software engineer at a desk in a modest, bright office in Addis Ababa, laptop open in front of her with a soft screen glow, looking up from the screen with a calm, confident smile, colleagues softly out of focus behind her, no readable text on any screen
shots.motion_prompt: slow tracking push-in as morning light reaches her face
shots.narration_am: ዛሬ የሶፍትዌር መሐንዲስ ነኝ፤ የተመኘልኝ ሰላም፣ ጥበብ እና ክብር በሕይወቴ አንድ በአንድ ተፈጸሙ።
shots.narration_en: Today I am a software engineer. The peace, wisdom and honour he wished for me came true in my life, one by one.

shots.reason: The emotional peak: gratitude as she holds her father's photograph, the ending the original brief described, mirroring the child's close-up in shot 3.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of the woman at home in the evening with gentle tears of gratitude, holding an old faded photograph of her father in both hands near her face, warm lamplight from off frame touching her face
shots.motion_prompt: slow subtle tilt up with soft light shift
shots.narration_am: በእያንዳንዱ ስኬቴ ውስጥ የአባቴን ንጹህ ልብ አስታውሳለሁ።
shots.narration_en: In every success of mine, I remember my father's pure heart.

shots.reason: A transition to the father's point of view; luminous sky instead of a literal heaven keeps it reverent for every faith.
shots.keyframe_prompt: wide ethereal view of soft luminous clouds and warm golden rays of morning light over Addis Ababa far below, the city small and calm under the sky, serene reverent atmosphere
shots.motion_prompt: slow forward drift through soft golden light
shots.narration_am: ከሰማይም አባቴ ሕይወቴን ሲያይ፣ ልቡ በደስታ ይሞላል።
shots.narration_en: And when my father looks on my life from heaven, his heart fills with joy.

shots.reason: Closes the circle on the father's face: the joy of the one who gave the blessing.
shots.keyframe_prompt: medium close-up of the father bathed in radiant, peaceful golden light against soft luminous clouds, looking down with a joyful, thankful smile, peaceful
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle hold with soft golden glow
shots.narration_en: Seeing his daughter live by his blessing, he rejoices.
